title: Checkpoint: the sandwich count
prompt:
A 'sandwich' is three consecutive elements where the first and third are equal but the middle differs (like `1,9,1`). Count the sandwiches in the array (overlapping counts: `1,9,1,9,1` contains three).

Implement `process(int[] arr)` (0 for fewer than three elements).

tests.name: sandwich count
tests.hint: Loop i from 1 to length-2: arr[i-1] == arr[i+1] && arr[i] != arr[i-1].
